generation_history.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: CosyWorld character sprite, sleeping pose, genuine transparent RGBA background, portrait canvas 1024 x 1536.
Input image 1 is the approved Vale character and is the identity, costume, palette, and painterly rendering reference. Edit this character into a peaceful sleeping pose.
Subject: exactly the same young adult traveller Vale, with short tousled black hair, the same face, skin and adult proportions, long charcoal-black coat with brass fastenings, ivory open-collar shirt, dark trousers, leather belt and worn buckled black boots.
Pose: seated comfortably on an implied flat floor, knees gently drawn up, forearms loosely crossed over the knees, cheek resting naturally on one forearm. Eyes fully closed, brow relaxed, soft peaceful expression. Turned three-quarter toward the viewer's right. Clearly asleep in safety, not hurt, sad, collapsed, or defeated. Natural hands and anatomy. Both boots and the whole coat are visible.
Composition: keep the original adult head and body scale rather than enlarging the head; the compact seated figure occupies roughly the lower 60% of the 1024x1536 canvas, with its lowest boot/coat at about 96% height and clear transparent margin on every edge. Empty upper area is transparent. No crop.
Style: match exactly the source's warm painterly storybook finish, ink-like edge detail and softly textured cloth. Soft light on the figure only.
Constraints: preserve Vale's identity and all costume details; no scarf for this neutral variant; no lantern, no held objects, no bed, furniture, floor, cast shadow, scenery, glow halo or background. No text, lettering, sleep symbols, Zs, watermark or border. Actual alpha transparency outside the solid opaque character, including gaps between limbs; preserve soft antialiased painted edges.

validation.source_alpha: Seventeen WebPs preserve raw generated alpha byte for byte. Vale scarf preserves alpha after the separately recorded integer canvas translation; it is not byte-identical to the untranslated raw alpha array.
validation.alpha_limits: The generated files have maximum alpha254; very faint edge pixels are retained rather than thresholded. No alpha repair is applied.
validation.references: Every repository reference is pinned by commit and SHA-256. Every generated edit target is identified by generation ID, original PNG hash and its complete prompt/reference history.
validation.derivatives: Eighteen 512x768 card and eighteen 640x960 phone WebPs were read from the official image manifest and actual files. All hashes match that manifest; each decoded alpha channel exactly equals the complete source resized with the owning builder settings. Stage entries alias the unchanged source WebPs.
